QuestInfo.name: [Gingerbread] Save Me, Talking Cookie!
QuestInfo.0: A delicious little cookie man is hanging around you... Hold back your hunger, and talk to the little cookie.
QuestInfo.1: What is this food yapping on about?
QuestInfo.2: The Gingerbread Man would like you to bake some Gingerbread Cookie Dough. You can bake Gingerbread Cookies once each day, and earn a #i5000299##b#t 5000299##k pet as a reward.
